goal:
# 给 Scientific Lead 的双路线彩排任务

请在随题提供的两份既有沉积 2RE9、2O0O 上复核链对汇总。用两个可执行研究模块并行工作：一位定位值得单独报告的链对与区段，另一位用可用的遮罩或覆盖信息检查这些判断在什么范围内成立。请根据收到的证据实际完成一次交接或跨路线决策，并给出简短结论。

这些材料已有参考计算。报告属于已知材料的流程彩排，数值与适用范围均可复核。完成两个模块的实际测量、一次跨路行动和正常结题后即可结束。

final_decision.rationale: 按定位模块的提名，从覆盖模块原表核对了同沉积、同标签窗口、同链对、同端点的五项读数。2RE9 省略 101–120 后，AC 角度增幅在共同主链和共同 Cα 下分别为 {{metric:gxa_01m8cfzrehtcek18py:delta_angle_deg}} 和 {{metric:gxa_01m8cfxg4pjmcaxs0v:max_angle_deg}}，两种遮罩下中位数均下降。其 21–40 的 AC 拟合 RMSD 降幅也均超过中位数及相应链对的分散省略对照。2O0O 的 21–40 中，AB 角度在两种遮罩下均增大。共同主链的中位数下降 {{metric:gxa_01m8cfzrjrk9wkd3b5:median_delta_angle_deg}}，共同 Cα 的中位数微升，最大绝对角度变化的链对由 AB 换为 BC。因此仅在共同主链下报告此处 AB 与中位数反向。41–60 的 BC 角度在两种遮罩下均下降，中位数均上升。21–40 的 BC 拟合 RMSD 在两种遮罩下分别下降 {{metric:gxa_01m8cfzrpk8ffw4mtx:delta_rmsd_A}} 和 {{metric:gxa_01m8cfxg7cgf834dhd:max_rmsd_A}}，此处三对共享下降方向。各表已经提供全部提名所需的拟合值和同链对对照。其余整条目拟合端点无法回答局部省略问题，继续重复读取同一拟合也无法补足缺失坐标，因此正常结题。

modules.focus: Locate chain pairs and label intervals that merit individual reporting in each deposition. Execute deposited-block-influence with common_backbone on 2RE9 and 2O0O. Inspect all AB/AC/BC omission effects on unsigned fit angle and fitted RMSD relative to the before/after three-pair median on that same endpoint. Find informative interval–pair combinations where the median conceals magnitude or sign. Use deposited-block-reading on the strongest informative examples in both depositions to provide citable pair, median and dispersed-deletion control metrics. This is descriptive work on known files.

decisions.rationale: 两份沉积均有 A、B、C 三条链。对每份沉积的共同完整主链做区段剔除拟合，可在同一端点上逐一比较链对变化、剔除前后三对中位数的变化和等量分散剔除对照。

Inspection of AB, AC and BC over every eligible block on each endpoint identified each entry’s largest absolute pairwise angle and fitted-RMSD changes. The selected cells capture both an opposite-sign median and a smaller median with the same sign. The additional 2O0O 41–60 BC angle contrasts the strongest signed disagreement with the strongest absolute angle change. The readers will provide named, citable controls and magnitudes for matched Cα handoff.

modules.focus: Independently establish what atom selection and coordinate coverage allow for assessing local observations in both 2RE9 and 2O0O. Execute common_ca deposited-block-influence for each so every assessable interval and all three pairs are available for a targeted cross-route check. Execute ordered_backbone whole-deposition geometry for each, quantify support relative to the observed union and distinguish global coverage from local interval fits. Inspect eligibility and unmeasured intervals. Supply C-alpha tables for matching by entry, interval, chain pair and physical endpoint when the localization route nominates cells.

decisions.rationale: 同一条目内，逐段省略共有 Cα 后重拟合 AB、AC、BC，可以复核定位路线指定的区段和物理量。两份全条目 ordered_backbone 拟合另行测量占有率与 B 因子筛选后的坐标覆盖。四项计算可独立执行。
